narrativeProgression.description: Tutorial on removing black bars in fullscreen games.
Problem statement: Removing black bars in fullscreen games.
First step: Go to Screen Resolution settings.
Second step: Lower the resolution to the lowest option.
Third step: Navigate to Advanced Settings.
Fourth step: Open Intel Graphics and Media Control Panel (if applicable).
Fifth step: Change the 'Scaling' option to 'Scale Full Screen.'
Sixth step: Revert the resolution to the original setting.
